departments/agents only — no tool-grant table — so the default-deny allowlist lives here as policy
data, keyed by registry department slugs (generator rejects grants for slugs absent from the registry).
Default-deny: a department absent from 'grants', or a server absent from its entry, is DENIED.
Grant value: '*' = every non-quarantined tool of that server; or an explicit tool-name array.
'servers' is the launch catalog: only servers with a catalog entry can be emitted into a profile;
granted-but-uncatalogued servers are reported as pending_install, never emitted (profile stays loadable).

tables land wave-by-wave at Phase 10 department activation. ⛔ AUTHOR-ONLY: ADDING any grant here

[B36 Block 2, 2026-08-23] The git server's MCP SDK is now PINNED (`--with mcp==1.12.0`). Until this it was `uvx mcp-server-git==2026.7.10` with no SDK pin, so uvx resolved the newest `mcp` at every launch — and the newest one had moved: the server died at import with "'Server' object has no attribute 'list_tools'". Measured: 0 of its 12 tools could be enumerated on this machine, so the git capability was DEAD for every department that holds it, and nobody could see that because tool_pins still carried the 12 rows pinned on the day it last worked. Found when the construction site got its own database and had to pin the arsenal from scratch: a stale row and a live capability are not the same thing. With the pin the server answers again — 12 tools, git_status among them. A version pin on the server without one on the SDK it imports is not a pin.
